basic_info.description: Iconic, panoramic city & water views, grand scale, & impressive detailing inform this majestic Edwardian trophy in a lush, Buena Vista Park embrace.  This rare, expansive property, one of two TIC units, is on 2 levels with house-like proportions, 4 bedroom, 3 baths, over a spectacular, lofty social room. Aptly named The Ballroom this glamourous space - Band Practice/ Aerial Dance Class, Art Studio? is complete with wetbar, full bath & 4th bedroom/office & opens to a exclusive use, sheltered garden.  The beautifully articulated grandeur of its interior architecture, glorious light, polished finishes & central location create a vivid opportunity for sophisticated city dwellers: art collectors, those who entertain, nature lovers & San Franciscans who crave a dynamic city life. All levels of the property enjoy magnificent views, & the home offers ample storage & solid stewardship. This historic residence radiates the creative spirit, energy & livability that is uniquely San Francisco.
